input: What was the groundwater level in monitoring well GMW000000009441 in Amersfoort on 21 September 2026? Answer with only a JSON object with the key "level_cm_nap": the level in centimeters relative to NAP, rounded to whole centimeters.

metadata.hypothesis: The agent has to find the groundwater level series (GLD) of the well via its GMW, in the BRO relations or the BRO-loket, read a CSV or XML series, pick the right day and convert meters relative to NAP to centimeters. Likely failures: the depth below ground (about 348 cm) instead of the level relative to NAP, the level of another tube or well, the last measurement instead of the asked date, a guess.
